scope: Isolated two-T4 shape-only training. No Surface, appearance loss, RGB correction or combined method.

training.initialization: Robust epoch7 with fixed native logit offset -2; freeze its encoder/BatchNorm and train only its decoder.
training.precision: FP16 optimizer with GradScaler; FP32 native validation uses calibrated prior deterministic cuDNN, TF32 disabled, bias after native interpolation.
training.selection: Epoch zero is the calibrated parent, never a new model. Require full/hidden means >= max(training-GPU parent, recorded local parent); maximize hidden then full with stable ties. Quadro admission remains separate.
training.input_mix: 75% SAM support, 25% annotated support. Empty training SAM uses annotated branch, counted explicitly.
training.augmentation: 50% horizontal flip, 25% extra half-plane occlusion, visible-derived crop padding 1.5-3.0
training.loss: Per-object unweighted BCE(logits - 2, true amodal labels) outside observed input support; support is restored at inference.
training.distributed_sampling: DistributedSampler padding recorded; rank-zero BatchNorm buffers broadcast before native validation and checkpointing

inference_geometry.input: RGB restricted to SAM support, SAM mask and its complement
inference_geometry.native_probability: Resize logits to native crop before adding fixed -2 and sigmoid; zero outside crop; input SAM support set to one.

evaluation.validation: The existing 1264 objects / 217 images and recovered single-mask SAM diagnostic inputs
evaluation.hidden_truth: True amodal mask minus annotated visible mask, fixed across conditions
evaluation.status: Exploratory validation-driven development; no untouched confirmation claim
evaluation.success: The active all-four full-benchmark >=3% goal remains unchanged and unachieved; validation gains alone cannot satisfy it
evaluation.rationale: Original-initialization proper BCE improves full masks but remains below hidden floor through observed epoch13. Start from the existing calibrated robust prior to test whether its hidden-shape representation survives proper-loss decoder adaptation.
evaluation.benchmark_diagnostic_seen: The completed nonrandom 193-target frozen-v2 VG prefix has been observed; this is iterative research. No image-quality score enters training, checkpoint selection, or its validation constraint.
evaluation.platform_change: Separate exploratory protocol: exact same-device pixel repeat is required; cross-device initial differences are recorded, not called equality. Native Quadro admission and full benchmark remain mandatory and unchanged.
evaluation.previously_observed: Prior validation/holdout/prefix metrics and both Boolean mask operations were already observed. This is iterative development, not untouched confirmation.
